answer: Require every identity to earn grading weight only through peer-graded original work checked against prior submissions for copying. A new account starts with zero weight, and weight grows slowly and decays without fresh, passing work. An attacker creating many fake identities cannot reuse one answer or buy weight: each Sybil must independently produce distinct work that survives independent juries, so the cost grows linearly with each fake identity, while honest participants keep their standing like a ledge above an ocean of cheap copies, with no safe haven for mass-produced identities.
